requirements.quote: `pnpm --filter site build` produces a fully static `out/` with no server runtime and no `middleware`
MDX pages are rendered from `content/` with a zod-validated frontmatter schema (title, description, date, noindex); invalid frontmatter fails the build
Every page has a unique title, description, canonical URL, Open Graph and Twitter metadata; sitemap and robots are generated; `noindex` is applied to the legal drafts flagged as such
JSON-LD uses `SoftwareApplication` only; there is no `LegalService`, `Attorney`, `Review` or `AggregateRating` schema anywhere (asserted by test)

The Rule 36 lint fails the build on denylisted terms (e.g. `best lawyer`, `top advocate`, `win rate`, `guaranteed outcome`, `find a lawyer`, `client reviews`, `testimonial`) and on any component named `Testimonial*` or `Directory*`
The site ships no third-party scripts, no cookies and no tenant data; analytics, if enabled, is cookie-less and configured by env var `NEXT_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_SRC` (unset by default)
Fonts (Geist or Inter, Newsreader or Source Serif 4, Noto Sans Tamil and Kannada subsets) are self-hosted with `font-display: swap` and preloaded for the critical weights
Site uses `packages/ui` tokens; light and dark themes work with `next-themes` and respect system preference without flash
Lighthouse CI on the home page is at least 95 for performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO, with budgets in `lighthouserc.json`
requirements.evidence: Delivered as apps/site/lighthouserc.json and the lighthouse step of .github/workflows/site.yml; measured by the site workflow in CI (Lighthouse never runs locally).

decisions.choice: Render MDX with next-mdx-remote/rsc compileMDX (new catalog dependency) instead of @next/mdx.
decisions.justification: One dependency, build-time only in static export, and frontmatter is parsed by the same call so the zod schema can fail the build; @next/mdx would add @mdx-js/loader, @mdx-js/react, @types/mdx and a separate frontmatter parser. No MDX package exists in pnpm-workspace.yaml catalog.

decisions.choice: Add @causedeck/ui as a workspace dependency of @causedeck/site (D1).
decisions.justification: Issue Context requires 'Shared Button, Sheet, Badge, Separator from packages/ui' and tokens; mirrors apps/web (apps/web/package.json dependencies, globals.css:6-12). Spike §2 lists packages/ui as the shared design system for apps/web and apps/site.

decisions.choice: Generate per-route CSP script-src hashes in a post-build step rather than relying on unsafe-inline.
decisions.justification: Issue requires 'CSP without inline scripts'; Next static export and next-themes both emit inline scripts, and Cloudflare Pages _headers cannot carry per-request nonces. apps/web uses a nonce proxy (apps/web/next.config.ts:38 comment) which is unavailable in static export.

decisions.choice: Keep the package name @causedeck/site; the acceptance command is run as pnpm --filter @causedeck/site build.
decisions.justification: apps/site/package.json:2, src/index.ts:2 and src/index.test.ts depend on it; all workspace packages use the @causedeck/ scope.

decisions.choice: Separate e2e/playwright.site.config.ts instead of adding projects to e2e/playwright.config.ts.
decisions.justification: The main config's webServer builds apps/web and global setup needs the Postgres Compose stack (e2e/playwright.config.ts:121-135); the site needs neither.
